note: Physical pixel coordinates. WebView bounds: x 0-1080, y 300-1850. All in-game elements are inside WebView — appium_find_element cannot see them. Use appium_swipe(startX, startY, endX=startX, endY=startY) for coordinate taps.

grid.note: 5x5 grid of numbers. Column x-values and row y-values below.

reel.note: 1x5 horizontal reel of symbols below the grid

spin_button.intent: Start spin — large circular button at bottom center

end_game_button.intent: DO NOT TAP — touch target overlaps with spin button during extra spins phase
end_game_button.notes: DANGER: Use native header close_button instead. Never tap this coordinate.

game_over_dismiss.intent: Dismiss Game Over modal by tapping center
